name: Senlay
description: Senlay provides source-aware environmental context for autonomous systems, robotics and AI applications, including available observations, forecasts, provenance and unknowns.
primary_use_cases: Aerial, marine and field robotics applications using coordinate-level environmental context
AI agents and operators reviewing available evidence, source freshness and uncertainty
Drone environmental evidence review as a specialized workflow
core_capabilities: Coordinate-level environmental API with source-aware observations and model values where available
Timestamps, source distance, freshness/confidence components, conflicts, and unknowns
Multi-station wind screening flags suspect readings for review; it does not confirm sensor failure
Deterministic environmental evidence with a separate AI explanation in the Live Demo
Public MCP gateway with four tools: sense_location, check_operability, list_domains, get_forecast_trust
Reference robotics adapters and offline synthetic replay

authentication.trial: GET /api/v1/try-sense is available without an API key and is rate-limited.
authentication.production: Authenticated evaluation requests use Authorization: Bearer sl_live_... for /api/v1/sense, /api/v1/pwm, and /api/v1/risk-events. This does not establish commercial source rights or production readiness.
authentication.registration: POST /api/v1/agent-register with ownerEmail and agentName to create an agent key.

rate_limits.try_sense: 8 requests/minute burst and 60 requests/hour per IP.
rate_limits.free_beta: 100 authenticated API calls/day, shared across all active keys on a registered beta account.

safety_disclaimer: Senlay provides context, evidence, and decision support. It is not a safety authority. Final decisions remain with operators, users, and customer applications.

positioning.commercial_product: Physical-world intelligence infrastructure beta for autonomous systems and robotics; SmartSurf is the origin and reference application.
positioning.engine: The Physical World Model assembles available environmental context at a coordinate. For drones, Senlay presents wind observations and available model indications of rain and thunderstorms. Local rainfall and lightning are not directly measured by this assessment. Aircraft limits, route, altitude, visibility and operational permission remain outside its scope.
positioning.boundary: Operator review only; no launch authorization or robot control.

robotics_example.hardware_validation: reference fixtures only; real hardware validation pending
robotics_example.replay: Fully synthetic position and environmental evidence; no network or key required

commercial_availability: Evaluation beta. Commercial Open-Meteo access has not been arranged; commercial source rights and configuration require owner action.

mcp.protocol_version_policy: Negotiated by the MCP SDK during initialize; no fixed version is advertised in health metadata.
mcp.forecast_trust_default: UNKNOWN until sufficient eligible archived forecast-versus-instrument pairs
